scenes.text: The core rule is the ticket lifecycle. New, Open, Pending, Solved, then Closed. Nobody closes a ticket by hand. A job closes it four days after it's solved.

The most surprising gap was a boundary. One seeded ticket sat exactly on the Due soon line, so both answers were right. And a reopened ticket could stay assigned to an agent who'd been deactivated. Now it's unassigned.
Passing isn't production-ready. We never tested real sign-in, real email in and out, a real scheduler, or hosting. Check those before your team relies on it.
